description:
Free open-source YouTube downloader GUI based on yt-dlp for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Download videos, Shorts, 4K, 1080p60, HDR, and subtitles with no ads, tracking, cookies, or login. Supports 9 languages.

Arroxy is a free, open-source desktop app for downloading YouTube videos and Shorts in up to 4K, 1080p60, HDR, and audio-only formats with no ads, tracking, or login required.
Install
Windows Setup Windows Portable
macOS Apple Silicon macOS Intel
Linux AppImage Linux Flatpak Linux tar.gz
SHA256
Arroxy now reports less: no telemetry, just one anonymous heartbeat a day.
Highlights
- No telemetry, just a daily heartbeat. Arroxy used to report failures and crashes anonymously. Now it sends only one anonymous heartbeat a day — app version, OS, language, install channel and country — so we can count how many people use it. No IDs, URLs, video titles or file names. The switch in Settings is now called Send daily heartbeat, and if you had turned reporting off, it stays off.
What's Changed
- feat(heartbeat): replace telemetry with one anonymous daily heartbeat by @antonio-orionus in #283
